source.title: An analysis of two open problems of AVL tree insertion algorithm

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as the zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL https://zbmath.org/2050881 with trailing identifier 2050881.

Local workflow resolver rows in outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-1.csv and outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identify the exact zbMATH record title as 'An analysis of two open problems of AVL tree insertion algorithm' and year 2001, but provide no full-text link.

Failure modes: network_or_dns_failure for local shell fetches of api.zbmath.org; blocked_or_challenged or unreadable resolver output for the zbMATH web page; metadata_only for generic zbMATH search/help pages; and metadata-only exact-title pages that did not expose a readable full-text artifact. No readable PDF or HTML full-text artifact for the exact record was recovered.

Ran exact-work recovery searches using the zbMATH identifier, the exact title, the exact title plus PDF, the exact title plus WSEAS, and the title with author terms Ningping Sun, Ryozo Nakamura, Wenling Sun, and Akio Tada. Search results found ResearchGate metadata for the exact title but explicitly no full text, a WSEAS program PDF listing the exact title without the technical paper body, a Scribd conference-title/keyword listing, and related AVL-tree materials. The accessible 1998 paper 'An Approximate Analysis of the AVL Balanced Tree Insertion Algorithm' was rejected because its visible title and bibliographic data identify it as a different work.
